d2b_blit.pm4 — golden PM4 capture (X5000 RX 560, gcn-wb boot, 2026-07-17)
gcngfx rev: 956f0ab (capture hook build, EXTRA_CFLAGS=-DGCN_PM4_CAPTURE)
test: per-pixel 1:1 blit via POS_X/POS_Y, oracle: mismatch=0/4096 (PASSED)
shaders: gcn_vs_fullscreen + gcn_ps_blit (offline LLVM gfx803 blobs from gcn_shaders.c)
RT: 64x64 linear, CB 8_8_8_8 UNORM (TILE_MODE_INDEX=8 LINEAR_GENERAL)
embedded GPU (MC) addresses: RT 000000F4051C9000, TEX 000000F4051CD000, VS 000000F4051D1000, PS 000000F4051D2000
  - CB_COLOR0_BASE holds RT>>8; SPI_SHADER_PGM_LO/HI hold shader VA>>8/>>40
  - T# descriptor dwords 0-1 hold the texture base VA (tests with TEX/COMB/SRC)
masking rule: final 6 dwords = EVENT_WRITE_EOP + CACHE_FLUSH_AND_INV_TS fence
  (backend-owned per CONTRACTS.md §2) -- reference-only; its dwords [N-4],[N-3]
  embed the writeback address. Diff harness masks the EOP packet and all
  address-bearing words listed above.
format: raw little-endian uint32 stream, byte-identical to ring memory
capture: PM4CAP serial dump (COM7), reconstructed host-order->LE; boot's
  readback oracles all PASSED on the same run (serial log of 2026-07-17)
